release_notes:
LockStepPDF 4.1.2

This hot-fix replaces the installed program file. The zip contains LockStepPDF.exe and the matching _internal folder. The updater copies that program onto the file name already installed, including ReadySetPDF.exe. It does not remove folders already next to the program, so the LibreOffice folder stays and Office files still convert. This zip does not include LibreOffice. Tesseract and Labels are inside the program folder.

Crop marks: Size is the outer ink. Margin is the distance from the media edge to the nearest ink. A round dot is a filled disk of that Size. Thickness does not change the dot. Thickness still strokes the L marks, the cross, and the registration L.

Multi-up: Margins and gutters are measured to the cut. Bleed on the page draws outside that cut. Where two copies meet, each one keeps half the gutter. On the sheet edge, the bleed uses what fits in the margin. Crop marks stay on the cut.

Bleed: Finished trim W × H is optional and is saved with the Grow Bleed step. Leave it blank to keep the page trim. Type a size when the file has bleed and no trim box, or when that trim is wrong. Multi-up and Booklet pack on that page trim. You do not type the cut again in those tools. Bleed to show stays on Multi-up and only limits how much bleed is drawn.
